title: Collagenase Injection for Contracture Management
official: Collagenase Injection for Contracture and Spasticity Management
summary: The overall goal is to investigate the effectiveness of a novel intervention - Collagenase injection, for contracture management in patients with neurological impairments, such as stroke, brain injury, and spinal cord injury.
sponsor: The University of Texas Health Science Center, Houston

sites.f: The University of Texas Health Science Center at Houston
